morning.title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Morning Brief – 7 November 2026
morning.headline: Corruption Scrutiny Intensifies in Tamil Nadu as DVAC Books Duraimurugan Over Rs 1,427-Crore Sand Mining Scam
morning.big_picture_excerpt:
- DVAC Books DMK General Secretary Duraimurugan and 26 Others in Rs 1,427-Crore River Sand Mining Scam
- Periyar Arivulagam Book Procurement Controversy Triggers Statewide Political Outcry and Government Inquiries

evening.title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Evening Brief – 7 November 2026
evening.headline: Tamil Nadu Political Landscape Shaken as TVK Government Allocates ₹2,000 Crore for Student Laptops, Scraps Kurian Panel, and Confronts Opposition Over Controversial 'AI Book Scandal'
evening.big_picture_excerpt:
- Chief Minister Vijay Sanctions ₹2,000 Crore for Vetri Laptop Scheme to Empower College Students
- Tamil Nadu Government Probes Alleged 'AI Book Scam' Under Previous DMK Regime as Opposition Demands Anti-Corruption Inquiry
- Chief Minister Vijay Writes to Prime Minister Modi Opposing Karnataka's Mekedatu Dam Project and Central Site Inspections
